title: leontodon autumnalis subsp. microcephalus
intro: Leontodon autumnalis subsp. microcephalus, commonly known as Autumn Hawkbit, is a subspecies of the Leontodon autumnalis plant, which is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Autumn Hawkbit include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Autumn Hawkbit include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
